blogs.title: When a Young Woman's Fatigue is a Red Flag: Recognizing Telomere Biology Disorders in Adults
blogs.description: This post dissects the early clinical clues that should prompt clinicians to consider a telomere biology disorder (TBD) even in the absence of classic mucocutaneous features. We’ll walk through the diagnostic pitfalls of chronic fatigue and pancytopenia, highlight the importance of a multidisciplinary work‑up, and explain how a subtle constellation of premature greying, splenomegaly, and bone marrow failure can be the first sign of a hereditary telomere defect.

blogs.title: PARN‑Associated Syndromes: From Dyskeratosis Congenita to Pulmonary Fibrosis
blogs.description: PARN mutations are emerging as a unique phenotype within TBDs. This article explores the spectrum of monoallelic versus biallelic PARN variants, their mechanistic role in telomerase RNA maturation, and how a single missense change can drive life‑threatening lung and liver fibrosis in young adults. We’ll also review current genotype‑phenotype correlations and the clinical implications of classifying a variant of uncertain significance.

blogs.title: Pancytopenia and Fibrosis: When a Vitamin B12 Deficiency Isn't the Whole Story
blogs.description: A deep dive into the evaluation of pancytopenia that persists after correcting nutritional deficiencies. The blog will discuss the interpretation of peripheral blood smears, marrow findings, and hemolysis markers, while addressing how inherited telomere shortening can mask or mimic nutrient‑mediated marrow failure. We’ll outline a systematic approach to differentiate primary marrow disorders from secondary, genetics‑driven cases.

blogs.title: Hepatic and Pulmonary Fibrosis in the Young: An Overlooked Manifestation of TBDs
blogs.description: This piece examines how fibrotic disease of the liver and lungs can be the presenting feature of telomere biology disorders. Using imaging and elastography findings, we’ll explain the pathophysiology, screening algorithms, and longitudinal surveillance strategies for patients with confirmed or suspected TBDs, stressing the urgency of early detection to limit irreversible damage.

blogs.title: Managing a Multisystem Telomere Disorder: Supportive Care, Transplant Eligibility, and Genetic Counseling
blogs.description: An overview of current treatment options for patients with TBDs – from vitamin supplementation and bone marrow support to the role of hematopoietic stem cell transplant and emerging therapies like androgens. We'll cover how to assess transplant candidacy, discuss the psychosocial aspects of genetic counseling, and outline a holistic care pathway for systemic symptoms such as osteoporosis, neuropathy, and anemia.
